stories.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
stories.body: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

stories.title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
stories.body: "We'll make sure that people are able to watch it," the US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday.

stories.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
stories.body: Ukraine accused Russia of targeting two crowded vehicles in the front line city of Kramatorsk to kill as many civilians as possible.

stories.title: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC
stories.body: A lawyer says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is moving around her hospital room after surviving two lethal injections.

stories.title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design
stories.body: The German sportswear brand wants the Sydney-based label to stop selling the clothes and pay damages.

stories.title: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
stories.body: Hundreds have pitched their tents in central Madrid, while the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

stories.title: 'Bold and inventive' Canadian poet Anne Carson wins Nobel Literature Prize
stories.body: Carson, 76, is celebrated for works that often cross boundaries between poetry, fiction and scholarship.

stories.title: Venezuela's ex-leader Nicolás Maduro charged with conspiracy to commit torture
stories.body: The new accusations relate to the alleged torture of US citizens held in Venezuela while Maduro was in power.

stories.title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering, rights group says
stories.body: More than 500 migrants have been expelled from the US to African countries, HRW says, citing US data.

stories.title: Outspoken Indian actor Nana Patekar dies suddenly at 75
stories.body: Known for his intense performances, Patekar carved out a distinctive place in Indian cinema.

stories.title: Teacher who sexually abused pupil back in Indonesia jail after BBC investigation
stories.body: Mochamad Subchi Azal Tsani had been secretly released on parole in 2025, after serving less than half his sentence.

stories.title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
stories.body: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.

stories.title: Residents airlifted to safety after flooding in central Chile
stories.body: The Mapocho river has burst its banks after an unusually large amount of rain fell in recent days.

stories.title: Zambia signs US health deal after disputes over data-sharing
stories.body: The US will provide $1.5bn (£1.1bn) under the deal that was negotiated after Trump cut USAID funding.

stories.title: Tanker hit by multiple projectiles in Gulf off Qatar, maritime agency says
stories.body: Casualties have been reported on the vessel, identified by a maritime intelligence firm as the oil and chemical tanker, Acers.

stories.title: South Korea recalls Ukraine envoy over prisoner-of-war row
stories.body: It is the latest in a diplomatic spat after Kyiv disclosed that two North Korean prisoners were transferred to Seoul.

stories.title: Arizona congressional candidate says she was raped while repairing campaign sign
stories.body: Bernadette Greene-Placentia says her memory of the attack is spotty and that she was knocked unconscious.

stories.title: US and Lebanon protecting wanted Syrian general, BBC finds
stories.body: Bassam al-Hassan is being sheltered in return for information - including about abducted US reporter Austin Tice.

stories.title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says, as Miliband says 'vital services' to remain
stories.body: Israel said in September it would act in response to UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

stories.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies
stories.body: Maricarmen Abascal, 87, was forcibly removed on a stretcher from her apartment of more than 70 years in September.
